positions.name: AsyncRememberDispatchContract
positions.frame: what does the ratified async remember contract guarantee about dispatch, watching, and delivery of the extraction result?
positions.why: All three segments read in one direction: the settled (ratified, decision-labeled) shape of the async remember call — immediate receipt, non-blocking/no-loss guarantees, and the poll-or-piggyback delivery mechanism. Register and conviction readings mark all three as terse, technical, decision-grade statements of the same contract; the group holds together even though src-3 attributes the mechanism to a different speaker/footing than src-1/src-2's ratification framing — a tension of who is asserting vs. who is deciding, not of subject.
